name: Tusk
description: "When one possesses a hammer, it is frivolous to use a nail." Crushing overhead strikes bring even the largest enemies to their knees.

abilities.name: Power Attack
abilities.description: When dedicating at least 3 Stamina to an attack or Art, deal +1 damage (+2 with heavy/Tusk weapons). Area effects require +1 Tax Stamina.

abilities.name: Second Wind
abilities.description: Whenever ending turn with 0 Stamina, gain 1 Stamina.

abilities.name: Uproot
abilities.description: May attack empty squares for 1 Stamina, creating rough terrain. Burrowed creatures take 2 damage and surface.

abilities.name: Controlled Force
abilities.description: Taxed Stamina counts as dedicated for attack dice. Stamina spent to clear Off-Balance counts as dedicated for next attack.
